purpose: Record reviewed career-foundation source and passed application gates before verifying deployment admission.

deploymentPolicy.requirement: The connected Vercel project requires GitHub-verified commits.
deploymentPolicy.action: Use a normal GitHub server-side squash merge of documentation-only evidence into the feature branch; verify the resulting commit signature and deployment status independently.

limits: A signed head does not itself prove a successful build or release.
Local and GitHub browser checks use controlled service responses.
Production project access and exact deployment provenance require separate verification.
